scares.description: During a quiet moment, the screen suddenly clicks on, which may startle sensitive viewers.
Bjorn and Tyler try to remove the fuel canister in the cryo chamber, it hisses open and sprays freezing gas.
As Rain tries to retrieve Rook’s chip, he suddenly grabs her arm, accompanied by a booming sound effect.
A facehugger suddenly leaps from the water and attacks Bjorn.
Rook suddenly reactivates and thrashes, accompanied by a sound effect.
After the facehugger escapes through the hole in the floor, Navarro suddenly thrashes and screams.
A Facehugger suddenly leaps onto the window, startling Rain with a loud screech.
A flash of light reveals a hanging body behind Kay, accompanied by a sharp sound effect.
A sudden burst of electricity goes off, accompanied by a shrill sound effect.
After being attacked, the presumed-dead Xenomorph suddenly lunges.
A Xenomorph jumps into the grate above Kay as she crawls beneath it.
After an alarm is triggered, Tyler appears in the window behind Kay.
As Rain goes to jump, a screeching Xenomorph grabs her leg.
In a well-telegraphed scare, the new on-screen Xenomorph attacks with a roar.
During a quiet scene, the new Xenomorph bursts screaming from the sandy debris for a close-up attack.
